note: Recast from Ahmad (1965), the original in English; the alate (only the second half of the description was recovered), the large soldier and the small soldier are described, and the measurement tables are transcribed as they stand (alate 10 individuals, large soldier 14, small soldier 10; range and mean are given throughout). The last few measurements of the small soldier are not entered, because the original runs to the foot of the page and the scan is truncated there.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Large soldier: head reddish yellow, the margin of the frontal groove, the basal margin of the postclypeus and the antennal carinae reddish brown; labrum concolorous with the head; mandibles reddish brown; antenna pale with a brownish tinge; pronotum yellow, with a brownish tinge on the anterior and posterior margins. Head very sparsely hairy; labral tip with a fringe of short hairs (shorter in the middle), with 3 setae at the left anterior corner and 2 at the right anterior corner; postmentum with 3 setae near the anterior end of the lateral margins; pronotum with a few microchaetae in the middle of the anterior margin, 1 long seta on each lateral lobe and 1 on each posterolateral angle, otherwise bare. Head subquadrate; lateral margins slightly convex behind the posterolateral ends of the antennal carinae and slightly concave below them; widest in the basal 1/3; fontanelle round, with a groove in front. Postclypeus much wider than long, with a median groove. Anteclypeus short, membranous. Labrum about as wide as long, widest at the middle; tip transparent, weakly bilobed. Mandibles stout, sickle-shaped, strongly curved at the tip; left mandible with 2 marginal teeth, right with 1. Postmentum moderately arched, its greatest width a little more than 1.5 times the waist width; the constriction near the posterior margin. Antenna 16—17 segments; in the 17-segmented condition segment 2 is longer than segments 3 and 4. Pronotum projecting forward; lateral lobes small and broadly rounded, with a notch below them; posterior margin slightly concave at the middle. Large soldier measurements (mm, 14 individuals, range/mean): head length to the mandibular bases 1.45—1.61/1.54; head width at the mandibular bases 0.98—1.09/1.03; head width at the posterolateral ends of the antennal carinae 1.32—1.45/1.39; head width at the middle 1.40—1.61/1.50; left mandible length 0.85—0.93/0.91; distance from the first marginal tooth of the left mandible to the apical tooth 0.26—0.28/0.26; postmentum length 0.93—1.09/1.03; maximum postmentum width 0.40—0.46/0.42; minimum postmentum width 0.26—0.28/0.26; pronotum length 0.54—0.57/0.56; pronotum width 0.85—0.95/0.90; mesonotum width 0.80—0.88/0.84; metanotum width 0.90—0.95/0.92. Small soldier: head yellow; the lateral margins of the frontal groove, the posterior margin of the postclypeus and the antennal carinae reddish brown; labrum brownish yellow, transparent at the tip; mandibles pale reddish brown, paler at the base; pronotum pale brownish yellow, with a reddish tinge on the margins; legs pale. Posterior half of the head with a few long setae; postclypeus with 2 small setae; labral tip with a fringe of short hairs, and 2 short setae on each of the two apical lobes; 1—2 small setae on the lateral margins in front of the widest part of the postmentum; pronotum with very few hairs. Head with the sides nearly parallel at the middle, widest at the posterolateral ends of the antennal carinae; fontanelle round, with a groove running forward. Labrum elongate, extending beyond the mandibular tips, with a median longitudinal groove; tip bilobed. Mandibles slender, sickle-shaped; left mandible with 2 marginal teeth, right with 1 sharp marginal tooth. Postmentum arched and wide, its greatest width only slightly greater than the waist width; the constriction near the posterior margin. Antenna 15—16 segments; in the 15-segmented condition segment 2 is slightly longer than segment 3, and segment 3 slightly shorter than segment 4. Pronotum about 1.5 times as wide as long; anterior margin slightly projecting, without a notch; posterior margin slightly concave at the middle. Small soldier measurements (mm, 10 individuals, range/mean): head length to the mandibular bases 0.75—0.85/0.80; head width at the mandibular bases 0.48—0.54/0.49; head width at the posterolateral ends of the antennal carinae 0.70—0.78/0.72; head width at the middle 0.66—0.72/0.68; the left mandible length and the postmentum and pronotum measurements are truncated at the foot of the page in the original and are not entered.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: The original description of the alate of this species (head shape, eyes and ocelli, postclypeus, labrum, mandibular dentition, antenna of 20 segments, pronotum) begins on the preceding page, and only the second half was recovered: eyes large and convex, separated from the lower margin of the head by 1/4 of their diameter; ocelli broadly oval, their distance from the eye slightly less than their minor diameter; postclypeus somewhat conical, wide at the base and rounded at the tip, convex in lateral view and covering the anteclypeus; labrum wide, dome-shaped; left mandible with 3 marginal teeth (the second shorter than the first), right mandible with 2 marginal teeth and a distinct accessory tooth at the base of the cutting edge in front of the first marginal tooth; antenna 20 segments, segment 3 obconical and 1.5 times segment 2; pronotum slightly convex at the middle of the anterior margin and without a notch, the anterolateral margins broadly rounded, the posterior margin nearly straight. Alate measurements (mm, 10 individuals, range/mean): head length to the labral tip 1.61—1.71/1.65; head length to the mandibular bases 1.09—1.21/1.15; head width (across the eyes) 1.61—1.66/1.62; eye major diameter 0.39—0.46/0.40; eye minor diameter 0.33—0.39/0.37; distance from the lower margin of the eye 0.07—0.11/0.09; ocellus length 0.14—0.16/0.15; ocellus width 0.10—0.13/0.11; ocellus to eye 0.06—0.10/0.08; pronotum length 0.78—0.83/0.79; pronotum width 1.35—1.40/1.38.
